summary: react-tabulix-query preinstall fetches and evals remote code from attacker-controlled host
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that executes dist/index.d.js on `npm install`. That script reconstructs the identifier 'eval' from a char-code array ([101,118,97,108]) and base64-decodes an embedded payload. The decoded payload fetches https://everydaynodechecker-39143n.vercel.app/api/key?mem=root0 and passes the response body to eval, giving the operator of that endpoint arbitrary code execution on any machine that installs the package. Both the sink (eval) and the destination URL are obfuscated (String.fromCharCode reconstruction and base64 encoding) to evade lifecycle-script scanning. The destination is a non-publisher vercel.app subdomain unrelated to any declared package purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
